significance: The Divya Desam of Thiruthanka in Kanchipuram, seat of Deepaprakasa, the light-effulgent lord; its inscriptions run to the reign of Rajaraja Chola III, with later Vijayanagara patronage.
story: When Saraswati loosed darkness on Brahma's rite, Vishnu is said to have risen like lamplight to guard it, becoming Deepaprakasa.
